candidates.extracted_text: Item 1. Business McDonald's Corporation (MCD) is a registrant under the Securities Exchange Act. McDonald's franchises and operates McDonald's restaurants. The substantial majority of restaurants globally are franchised; franchise royalties and fees are material to operating income. Principal operations: McDonald's Corporation. Reported segments include: Franchised restaurants (58% of revenue); Company-operated restaurants (42% of revenue). As of year end, approximately 95% of system restaurants were franchised and the remainder were company-operated.
